steps.title: Obtain a Chugging barrel if you …
steps.text: Obtain a Chugging barrel if you have not yet already to save space. — You could optional try to add some Prayer regeneration potions to your setup for longer trips

steps.title: Make sure to have a troll …
steps.text: Make sure to have a troll stronghold teleport in your house

steps.title: Have blood burst or blood barrage …
steps.text: Have blood burst or blood barrage in your rune pouch. — If you would like, you could go out of your way to get Bloodbark armour. This might be nice to do if you plan to do a lot of GWD.

steps.title: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth until you get …
steps.text: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth until you get a zamorakian spear, then turn it into a zamorakian hasta. — Use some variation of the 6:0 range method. — Do this on a greater demons task. — Again, going for a Necklace of Anguish first is perfectly fine instead of using the fury. — Don't bother breaking down your crystal helm because this should be a short grind. — If you would like, you can also delay getting a hasta until you have a Scorching bow. See the notable alternatives section for more notes on delaying or skipping the hasta.

steps.title: (Optional but not recommended) Kill General …
steps.text: (Optional but not recommended) Kill General Graardor until you get Bandos tassets, a Bandos chestplate, and a Bandos hilt. — Use some variation of the 6:0 range method

steps.title: (Optional) Also kill Commander Zilyana for …
steps.text: (Optional) Also kill Commander Zilyana for a Saradomin godsword. — Use some variation of the ranged kiting method. — A Serpentine helm can be especially useful here to venom the minions at the start of each kill. — The Armadyl crossbow is of limited use without a Twisted Buckler. — You may also want to wait and come back with the Slayer level to kill spiritual creatures.

steps.title: Do not kill Kree'arra at this …
steps.text: Do not kill Kree'arra at this time
